title: Kinetic Identity Reel
description: Tactile physics, frame-accurate momentum, and micro-delight motion branding.
details: A high-energy reel testing physics-driven transitions, optical momentum curves, and micro-delights for modern web and native experiences.

title: Polaroid Camera Shader
description: Interactive instant camera app with real-time film emulsion shaders.
details: A custom WebGL canvas implementation simulating analog film development curves, grain density, and light leaks in real-time.

title: Canvas OS & Spatial Nodes
description: Infinite spatial workspace with physics-based node links, gesture flow, and spring depth.
details: An experiment in infinite visual node mapping, bi-directional connections, and spring-driven card layout algorithms.

title: Screentime Thermal Print
description: Visualizing personal digital consumption as thermal printed store receipts.
details: Translating screen time analytics into physical receipts with itemized application usage, pickup metrics, and digital wellbeing summaries.

title: Holographic Foil Shader
description: Multi-layered rainbow holographic card reflection with dynamic cursor glare.
details: Real-time 3D tilt matrix transformation calculating specular light reflections and spectral color dispersion as the mouse traverses the card surface.

title: Malleable Medium
description: Software is the ultimate malleable medium — interfaces should feel responsive, tactile, and alive.
details: Notes on UI polish: unseen details compound into something that feels right. Good default physics and intentional easings make software feel human.

title: Analog Studio Portrait
description: Hand-printed studio portrait on warm heavyweight textured stock paper.
details: Studio self-portrait taken in Minneapolis with physical medium format camera.

title: Spatial Vision UI
description: Designing spatial gesture primitives & dynamic glass materials for visionOS.
details: Explorations in spatial interface design, exploring eye-tracking affordances, translucent glass depth, and physical gesture feedback for spatial computing platforms.

title: Fluid Gesture Physics
description: Spring-interruptible continuous direct-manipulation gestures with momentum carry-through.
details: Direct manipulation gesture controller handling interruptions, momentum transfer, and spring physics.

title: Chroma Depth Pass
description: Multi-pass post-processing shader decomposing depth buffers into optical chromatic fringing.
details: Real-time post-processing pipeline for web shaders.

title: Synthesizer & Audio Wave
description: Micro-frequency synthesized clicks and tactile audio designed for zero-latency feedback.
details: Interactive audio visualizer built with Web Audio API, mapping oscillator frequencies to smooth spring-animated waveform paths.

title: Typographic Mesh Distortion
description: Interactive vertex-displaced typography reacting to pointer velocity and pressure.
details: Interactive vertex shader deforming type mesh geometries based on cursor velocity vectors.
